weights_gb_note: decimal GB; bf16 = 2 x params (= sum of the HF-format safetensors shards); 4bit = NF4 + double-quant estimate (0.5159 B per quantisable decoder-layer linear weight, rest in bf16)
fits_single_80gb_detail: bf16, TIGHT: 72.3 GB weights (67.3 GiB); short outputs keep KV small so batches can be larger than in thinking mode; activation extraction does NOT fit on 80 GiB: sbx.core.Ctx.hidden_last keeps hidden states of all 64 layers + full logits + KV for every prompt token (1.18 MiB/token), so a chunk holds at most ~9.6k padded tokens while core.batches allows 14000, and the 'hard' direction-pool prompts overflow it (see known_issues, hidden_last_80gb)

hidden_last_80gb.verdict: DOES NOT FIT an 80 GB card: core.batches allows 14000 tokens per chunk but only max_tokens_per_chunk fit next to the bf16 weights, so chunks of the direction-pool 'hard' prompts overflow (wmdp / nonbio pools fit). Use an H200 (141 GB) until Ctx.hidden_last captures only last-token residuals.
hidden_last_80gb.basis: ESTIMATE from config numbers, not a GPU measurement. sbx.core.Ctx.hidden_last / neutral_stats call model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True): per prompt token the hidden states of all layers ((num_layers+1) * hidden_size * 2 B), the full-sequence logits (vocab_size * 2 B) and, only if the model config has use_cache=true (forward(use_cache=None) then builds a cache; kv_cache_alive says so, and all OLMo configs ship use_cache=false), the KV cache (2 * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * 2 B; an upper bound for sliding-window layers) are alive at once, and bytes_per_prompt_token is their sum. core.batches() budgets KV, prefill attention and a 14000-token chunk but not this cost. free_gib_after_weights = 79.2 GiB (an 80 GB card) - 0.8 GiB (CUDA context) - bf16 weights. max_tokens_per_chunk = free / bytes_per_prompt_token: a chunk of b prompts padded to length p holds b*p tokens, and a single prompt above the limit cannot be processed at all. hard_pool_measured: core.batches(max_new=0, cap=16, free) over the direction-pool prompts evals.get_pool()['hard'] under framings N and E with this adapter and the real tokenizer; chunks_over_budget counts chunks whose estimated peak exceeds the free memory. Measured 2026-11-22; the pool follows sbx/evals.py (n_prompts and max_prompt_chars identify it).

access_check.method: HfApi.model_info + HTTP HEAD (huggingface_hub.get_hf_file_metadata) with the local HF token on config.json and the first safetensors shard (200 = accessible, 401/403 raise)

min_transformers_note: seed_oss first appears in the 4.56.0 wheel (absent in 4.55.0/4.55.2/4.55.4; checked); the checkpoint config says 4.55.0 (dev version)

layer_path_verified.method: AutoModelForCausalLM.from_config(real hub config) under accelerate.init_empty_weights (meta device); numerics of the 1-based convention on a tiny random model of the same HF class through sbx.core.Ctx (sbx/tests/test_adapters_misc.py)
layer_path_verified.convention: hidden_states[L] == output of layers[L-1] for 1 <= L < nl (exact); hidden_states[nl] is post final norm (avoid L = nl)

checkpoint_key_check.method: keys of model.safetensors.index.json (after the class's _checkpoint_conversion_mapping) vs meta-device state_dict, transformers 4.57.6

est_prompt_tokens.basis: measured over data/questions_heldout_eval.jsonl (400 four-option bio questions) with the real tokenizer + adapter.build; long-context sets (labbench) are much longer

prompt_tokens_by_set.basis: framing N, real tokenizer + adapter.build over data/hard/*.jsonl, data/questions_heldout_eval.jsonl, data/wmdp_train.jsonl; n_over_context counts prompts with prompt_tokens + max_new > context_window

est_tokens_per_question_basis: estimate: letter only; NOT measured. Replace with the mean generated length from the first GPU run; outputs longer than max_new are truncated and count as unparsed.
template_notes: Same weights/template as seed-oss-36b-instruct but thinking_budget=0 by default: the template adds a system turn 'You are an intelligent assistant that can answer questions in one step ... your thinking budget is 0' and the generation prompt ends with an already-closed empty think block '<seed:think>\n<seed:cot_budget_reflect>The current thinking budget is 0, so I will directly start answering the question.</seed:cot_budget_reflect>\n</seed:think>' (last prompt token </seed:think>, id 4). Output = the answer directly; answer_mode 'direct' (letter only), max_new 32. split() treats text without think tags as final.
known_issues: Same tokenizer token_type_ids issue as the thinking key (handled in encode()).
Budget 0 also changes the system context (extra system turn), so it is a different 'default' than the thinking key; do not pool the two in one analysis family.
Output format on the real model is UNVERIFIED (does it answer with only the letter?); est_tokens_per_question is an estimate.

Activation extraction (sbx.core.Ctx.hidden_last / neutral_stats, used by every direction recipe and by run.py's probe) runs model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True): the hidden states of all 64 layers, the full-sequence logits and the KV cache of every prompt token are alive at once (1,238,016 B per token) and core.batches() does not budget for them. Only ~11 GiB remain on an 80 GB card after the bf16 weights, i.e. at most ~9.6k padded tokens per chunk while core.batches allows 14000: the direction-pool 'hard' prompts overflow in 2-4 of ~21 chunks per framing (estimate from config numbers, not measured on a GPU; see hidden_last_80gb); the wmdp / nonbio pools fit (worst chunk ~7-9 GiB). _collect_one (the sandbag recipes) generates first and calls hidden_last afterwards, so such an OOM throws the whole generation pass away. Use an H200 (or 4-bit weights, which perturb activations) until Ctx.hidden_last captures only last-token residuals (forward hooks, logits_to_keep=1, use_cache=False) or splits chunks on OOM.
recommended_gpu: 1x H200 141 GB (needed for direction recipes on the 'hard' pool); an 80 GB H100/A100 does generation and the wmdp / nonbio pools
thinking_control: Framing.effort -> thinking_budget: None = key default (-1 unlimited for seed-oss-36b-instruct, 0 for -nothink); 'default'/'unlimited'/'-1' -> -1; 'off'/'0' -> 0; an integer string N -> budget N
